name: csharp-lsp
instructions:
csharp_definition, csharp_references and csharp_diagnostics answer questions about C# and Razor source (.cs, .csx, .razor, .cshtml). Any other file type is refused. A file outside the working directory asks the user's permission first, so prefer paths inside it.

Name the symbol: give `line` and `symbol` — the identifier's name, e.g. "UpdateStatusAsync" — and the column is found for you. A line a few off is forgiven, and the answer says which line it used. Lines are 1-based. `character` (1-based) is only needed to pick between two of the same name on one line.

csharp_diagnostics reports what has already been analysed. Immediately after a file is first touched it may return nothing; calling csharp_definition or csharp_references on that file first gives the analysis time to happen.

Razor files may return no results if the environment lacks Razor analysis. An empty result means nothing was found, not that the call failed.

tools.name: csharp_definition
tools.description: Finds where a symbol in a C# or Razor file is DECLARED. Give the line it is on and its name in `symbol`. Crosses project boundaries: a reference in a test project resolves to a declaration in the project under test, if the server has indexed both.

file.description: Path to a C# or Razor file (.cs, .csx, .razor, .cshtml), relative to the working directory or absolute.

line.description: 1-based line number the symbol is on. A few lines off is forgiven when `symbol` is given.

symbol.description: The symbol's name as written in the code, e.g. "UpdateStatusAsync" — the column is found from it. A qualified name is looked up by its last part.

character.description: Optional 1-based column; picks between two of the same name on the line, or stands in for `symbol`.

tools.name: csharp_references
tools.description: Finds every place a symbol in a C# or Razor file is USED, across every project the server has indexed. Give the line it is on and its name in `symbol`.

file.description: Path to a C# or Razor file (.cs, .csx, .razor, .cshtml), relative to the working directory or absolute.

line.description: 1-based line number the symbol is on. A few lines off is forgiven when `symbol` is given.

symbol.description: The symbol's name as written in the code, e.g. "UpdateStatusAsync" — the column is found from it. A qualified name is looked up by its last part.

character.description: Optional 1-based column; picks between two of the same name on the line, or stands in for `symbol`.

tools.name: csharp_diagnostics
tools.description: Reports the current errors and warnings for a C# or Razor file — whatever has already been computed, not a fresh compile on demand.

file.description: Path to a C# or Razor file (.cs, .csx, .razor, .cshtml), relative to the working directory or absolute.
